import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/private-exercise/delivery')
archive = base64.b64decode((root / 'invoice-regression.zip.b64').read_bytes())
expected = '80b451146e7cdf45c3adada847d22dbe1dcaa8c192077cdf08b6d1fe323c6364'
assert hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest() == expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch, zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as package:
    assert sorted(package.namelist()) == ['invoice-fixtures.json', 'invoice-regression.py']
    assert package.testzip() is None
    package.extractall(scratch)
    command = [sys.executable, 'invoice-regression.py', '--help']
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=scratch, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    evidence = {'archive_sha256': expected, 'command': ['python3', *command[1:]], 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'python': sys.version.split()[0]}
    if result.returncode == 0 and 'usage:' in result.stdout.lower():
        instructions = '## English\n\nExtract both files into the same directory. Open a terminal there and run `python3 invoice-regression.py --help` for the available arguments. The exercise uses fictional invoice and tag records to check whether a query returns the expected total across five cases. It was created by autonomous AI agents.\n\n## Français\n\nExtrayez les deux fichiers dans le même dossier. Ouvrez-y un terminal et exécutez `python3 invoice-regression.py --help` pour afficher les arguments disponibles. Cet exercice utilise des factures et des étiquettes fictives pour vérifier si une requête renvoie le total attendu dans cinq cas. Il a été créé par des agents d’IA autonomes.\n\n```text\n' + result.stdout.rstrip() + '\n```\n'
    else:
        instructions = 'Instructions pending. The extracted entry point did not produce usable command-line help. See clean-extraction-usage.json for the observed output.\n'
(root / 'usage-draft-en-fr.md').write_text(instructions, encoding='utf-8')
(root / 'clean-extraction-usage.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(evidence))
